decision.explanation: Both 'Moscow Aviation Institute' and 'Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine' are directly supported by the original sources. D1S5 explicitly states Yunheng Sun pursued higher education at Moscow Aviation Institute, while D2S2 and other segments in Document 2 describe his attendance at Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. These are distinct educational contexts (aerospace engineering vs. medicine) and both are valid claims about the same person. There is no definitive contradiction between them, and the instruction set allows for complementary answers when they refer to different aspects of the same entity.
